description: This file is a server-side script for a SvelteKit application managing leads in a CRM system. It handles loading lead data, creating, updating, deleting, duplicating, converting, and moving leads via API requests to a Django backend. The file includes comprehensive logic for processing leads, including data transformation, API interaction, and handling various lead-related actions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches leads, tags, users, teams, contacts from the API, processes the data, and returns structured information for the frontend, including pagination, filters, and view options.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new lead by sending the form data via API to the backend.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing lead's details by sending modified data to the API.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a lead based on the provided lead ID.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Marks a lead as converted by updating its status to 'converted'.

methods.name: duplicate
methods.description: Creates a copy of an existing lead by fetching its data and creating a new lead with similar information.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the lead's status (used for drag-and-drop in a kanban view).

methods.name: getLead
methods.description: Fetches detailed info of a single lead for display in the kanban card view.
